A_claim_persisted_crash_before_offer: reconnect redelivery or expired lease recovery to assigned
B_offer_sent_crash_before_accept: no accepted state; same durable offer recovery
C_accept_received_crash_before_persisten: worker reconnects and repeats idempotent JobAccept; no false acceptance ACK exists
D_event_persisted_crash_before_ack: replay is deduplicated by event id/sequence and returns persisted contiguous cursor
E_result_validated_crash_before_ack: pending notification joins authoritative completed/superseded attempt and regenerates ResultAck
F_result_ack_sent_crash_before_close: duplicate ResultAck after reconnect is safe and carries identical hash/retention
cancel_before_delivery: pending command remains durable and is delivered with the same command_id
gateway_restart_active_attempt: connection becomes offline; attempt is not failed
